metadata.title: PD5D Midbrain snRNAseq
metadata.description: This dataset contains single-nucleus (snRNAseq) raw data in FASTQ format for 108 midbrain samples from human subjects. Individuals with incidental Lewy body disease, clinical PD, and healthy control were included.
